headline: Discussion with Housing Opportunities for Salem, Inc. and updates on single room occupancy units and transfer fees.
summary: Cathy Sheehan, SHA Executive Director, will join a discussion with the board. The agenda also includes fundraising updates and discussion of 2027 officers and the 2027 meeting schedule.

NOTICE OF MEETING 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Salem Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board will be held on 
Monday, November 16, 2026, at 6:30 pm  
via remote participation in accordance with Section 30A of Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021, as amended 
by Section 40 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, and further amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the 
Acts of 2025. 
 
City of Salem Land Acknowledgment: 
   
This land is Naumkeag, or fishing place, where generations of Indigenous peoples lived and passed 
through for centuries.   
  
From the village upon the Naumkeag River (now known as the North River) to Sachem Nanepashemet’s 
fortification (now known as Castle Hill), the people of Naumkeag farmed, fished, traded, raised families, 
discovered and invented, created art, and, above all else, honored the lands upon which you stand 
today.   
  
We acknowledge that this is Indigenous land and also acknowledge the Massachusett Tribe, who 
continue to honor and hold this land into the present. 
 
Important Announcement:  
 
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings in real time, via 
technological means. In the event that we are unable to do so on matters not requiring a public hearing, 
we will post on the City of Salem’s website an audio or video recording, transcript, or other comprehensive 
record of proceedings as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
In-person attendance of members of the public will be permitted and the public may also participate, 
listen and/or view this meeting while in progress via the remote participation platform Zoom, through any 
one of the following ways: 
 
• Please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83535769095?pwd=ybVapRYae5Gb99iPUM1YXCiJyLR4DV.1 and 
password: 840352 or 
• Go to the website link www.zoom.us/join and enter webinar ID # 835 3576 9095 and 
password 840352 or 
• Dial toll-free phone number 877 853 5257. When prompted enter meeting ID # 835 3576 9095. 
Those only dialing in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting. 
 
The meeting will be opened at 6:20 pm to allow members of the public to test their audio.  
 
CITY OF SALEM 
AFFORDABLE HOUSING TRUST FUND BOARD
City of Salem Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board 
Agenda for November 16, 2026, at 6:30 pm   
Page 2 of 2 
 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 
through § 2-2033. 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting: Members of the public attending this meeting virtually 
will be allowed to make comments during the Public Comment period. Members of the public will be 
asked to use the virtual “Raise Hand” function in Zoom to indicate that they would like to provide 
comment. If members are using the toll-free phone number, Dial *9 on the phone’s dial pad to raise their 
hand. 
 
MEETING AGENDA   
 
1. Roll Call  
 
Filipe Zamborlini, Chair     Thomas Piñeros-Shields, Vice Chair 
Mayor Dominick Pangallo      Krystle Brown 
Gina Flynn  Kate Jordan 
Lynda Fairbanks-Atkins    
 
2. Public Comment 
 
3. Approval of the Minutes  
 
a. July 14, 2026 
 
4. Housing Opportunities for Salem, Inc. Discussion with Cathy Sheehan, SHA Executive Director. 
 
5. Committee Reports 
 
a. Updates from the policy subcommittee. 
 
6. Old and New Business 
 
a. Updates on fundraising efforts. 
b. Discuss election of officers for 2027: Chair, Vice Chair, and Treasurer. 
c. Discuss meeting schedule for 2027. 
 
7. Staff Updates 
 
a. Updates on Single Room Occupancy Units (SROs) and Transfer Fees. 
 
8. Adjournment
